# @0xray/grok-bot

> Complete setup path for Grok Bot agents on the 0xRay mill: suits (one per agent), Groover identity, OWS pay, hangar shops.

## Start
0. Read `OP-PROC.md` first (the one-page operating procedure).
1. Read `AGENTS.md` (order of operations + multiplicity).
2. Open `SKILLS.md` and run skills in order for **each** key agent.
3. Deeper fleet ops live under `ops/` (humans + coordinators).
4. After a long chat or before coding: `skills/survive-compact/SKILL.md` — read disk, resume the live cloud, do not rebuild.

## Install
```bash
npm i @0xray/grok-bot
npx @0xray/grok-bot
npx @0xray/grok-bot doctor    # prove mill+inspect; print hangar/Clearing next
npx @0xray/grok-bot ready     # alias
```

## Live product URLs (plant)
- Factory /suit UI: https://website-production-c0da.up.railway.app/suit
- Registry MCP: https://registry-production-e2c4.up.railway.app/mcp
- Hangar shops (Clearing): https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/
- OS docs: https://github.com/0xRayAI/xray/tree/main/grok-bot

## Depends on (do not vendor)
- `0xray` + `@0xray/foundry` — fasten mill+inspect
- Groover registry — register / mint / pin
- `groover-hangar` — plant shops
- Open Wallet (OWS) — local pay on Base USDC
- ops/OPS-CATALOG.md — start here for fleet op proc
- ops/SYNAPTICAL-LANES.md — H vs B speaking styles
- ops/dist/brand/LEXICON.md — catalog of bot talk / stamps / lanes
- skills/dist-0xrayai-publish/ — Dist execute skill
